candidates.name: Sarah Fowler Arthur
candidates.background: Ohio House member since January 2021. The Ohio House biography says she served on the State Board of Education from 2013 to 2020, was first elected in 2012, worked on her family farm, and began Sarah's Eggs at age 11.
promises: 2026 Ohio Gun Owners survey: opposes 'mental health' legislation that would deny law-abiding Ohioans gun rights without due process; would co-sponsor legislation eliminating restrictions on lawful gun owners carrying in 'gun-free' areas
record: The Ohio House lists primary sponsorships on HB 38, HB 43, HB 59, HB 70, HB 333, HB 369, HB 375, HB 433, HB 481, HB 733, and HB 734. The House lists HB 433 as enrolled and HB 733 as passed by the House.
In 2021, voted against House Resolution 69, which expelled Representative Larry Householder; the resolution passed 75–21.
YEA votes on HB 99 and HB 227 on November 17, 2021.
Primary-sponsored HB 403, requiring reports when teachers retire under threat of disciplinary investigation, and HB 235, regarding State Board membership and meetings. HB 235 did not pass the House.
candidates.correlation: 2026 survey positions (gun-rights expansion) are consistent with 2021 votes for HB 99/HB 227. Legislative output centers on education regulation, occupational-licensing reform, and commemorative bills. Vote against Householder expulsion was a notable break with the 75-member bipartisan majority, without a contemporaneous public explanation found.
